_comment: ACE-Step 1.5 text-to-audio API workflow. Verified against local ComfyUI v0.17.0 on 2026-07-27; key/meter templated 2026-08-15 against v0.33.0. WHAT IS DELIBERATELY NOT TEMPLATED, so it is not 'fixed' later: (1) node 5 cfg_scale/temperature/top_p/top_k/min_p are byte-identical to the node's own defaults and are flagged advanced by ComfyUI - hardcoding them is inert, not a bug; (2) node 5 generate_audio_codes must stay true - the tooltip says disable it only when supplying an audio reference, and this workflow has no audio input; (3) node 8 cfg=1.0 and node 4 shift=3.0 are the TURBO recipe, co-dependent with acestep_v1.5_turbo in _requires - a non-turbo checkpoint needs its own workflow file, not an argument. NOTE steps is NOT part of that recipe and was wrongly pinned at 8 until 2026-08-15: 8 is what turbo is distilled for, but 40 sounds audibly better and costs +2.5s on a 60s song (8 steps 0.65s sampling, 40 steps 3.10s, both at ~12.5 it/s). Do not re-pin it on the theory that a distilled model is converged - that theory was tested by ear and lost, while the spectral proxy that supported it (rolloff moved 3.8k->4.3k) did not predict what was audible; (4) node 7 batch_size must stay 1 because the caller reads items[0] and would silently discard the rest; (5) negative prompts are INERT here - at cfg 1.0 ComfyUI skips the uncond branch entirely (comfy/samplers.py), so node 6 exists only to satisfy KSampler's required negative input.
